scope: Teacher persona; documented module blueprint with clearly marked proposed extensions

modules.title: Account & access
modules.description: Enter the right school workspace and keep your account secure.

modules.title: My teaching day
modules.description: See the next class and the work that needs attention.

modules.title: My classes
modules.description: See assigned teaching contexts and only the pupil facts needed for them.

modules.title: Attendance
modules.description: Record every pupil deliberately, submit once and know the outcome.

modules.title: Messages & families
modules.description: Communicate through approved audiences and child-specific relationships.

modules.title: Timetable & cover
modules.description: Understand published schedules and explicit temporary teaching assignments.

modules.title: Teaching & learning
modules.description: Plan, assign, review submissions and return useful feedback.

modules.title: Assessments
modules.description: Enter marks carefully and participate in controlled moderation and publication.

modules.title: Student support
modules.description: Refer concerns through a restricted, accountable route.

modules.title: My requests
modules.description: Request leave and review your own staff information without administrative authority.

modules.title: Resources & facilities
modules.description: Borrow, request or book permitted teaching resources.

modules.title: Assigned duties
modules.description: Carry out explicitly assigned school duties with minimal pupil data.

modules.title: Teaching assistant
modules.description: Use evidence-based drafts and retain human responsibility for every action.

workflows.title: Sign in to the school workspace

steps.title: School entry
steps.help: Published school branding helps recognition; it does not grant access.

steps.title: Authorized workspace
steps.help: Skip branch selection when only one branch is permitted.

workflows.outcome: My Teaching Day opens in the authorized branch.
workflows.rule: Resolve permissions server-side. A Teacher role alone does not establish employee identity, dated eligibility or class assignment.
workflows.recovery: Generic credential rejection; revoked/suspended access exposes no roster. Safe return URLs only.
workflows.data: Access reads global UserAccount, branch SchoolMembership/RoleGrant and institution/branch state; creates verified session/context.

workflows.title: Activate or recover a teacher account

steps.title: Account help
steps.help: Use the verified channel allowed by the institution and account-wide policy.

steps.title: Next steps
steps.help: The public response does not disclose whether the account exists.

fields.name: ack
fields.label: I will use the school’s verified recovery instructions.

workflows.outcome: A generic acknowledgement explains the permitted next step.
workflows.rule: Existing operator-issued and email-issued paths coexist. A stricter active institution can prevent an account-wide email reset at issue and consumption.
workflows.recovery: Expired/revoked/consumed/failed-delivery tokens fail safely. Resend and compromised-inbox recovery use their documented owner workflows.
workflows.data: Access owns token hashes, policy evaluation, single-use consume, session invalidation and sanitized delivery evidence. No secrets in drafts or audit.

workflows.title: Switch branch or leave the workspace

steps.title: Destination
steps.help: Only authorized branches appear.

steps.title: Unsaved work
steps.help: An unsubmitted attendance draft is held in memory only in Phase 1.

fields.name: leave
fields.label: I have reviewed unsaved work before leaving.

workflows.outcome: Context switches after authorization, or the current session ends.
workflows.rule: Warn before discarding input; clear old-branch protected state/caches. A saved or submitted record belongs to its original branch.
workflows.recovery: Permission lost during switch shows a safe destination. Unknown submission must be resolved before the draft is discarded.
workflows.data: Access resolves target scope or revokes session. Business commands and request receipts remain owner-scoped.

workflows.title: Review my account and sessions
workflows.capability: self.read; self-service session actions must match existing Access contract

steps.title: My account
steps.help: Review only your own safe account and branch memberships.

steps.title: Account action
steps.help: Role, employee identity and permissions are changed by their authorized owner.

workflows.outcome: The teacher understands their identity, access and permitted account actions.
workflows.rule: No self-service role escalation, arbitrary branch addition or global identity editing. Listing/revoking other own sessions is an extension unless the repository already supports it.
workflows.recovery: A stale or expired session returns to school sign-in; never disclose token material.
workflows.data: Access self DTO from UserAccount/session/membership; no salary, guardian grant or administrator-only record joins.

workflows.title: Plan my teaching day

steps.title: Choose the date
steps.help: The school-local date determines the schedule.

steps.title: Next action
steps.help: Show sessions in time order with their actual state.

workflows.outcome: The teacher reaches the right class with a clear next action.
workflows.rule: Scheduled, open, submitted and cancelled are distinct. A missing register never creates absence records. No unrelated school-wide student counts.
workflows.recovery: No sessions is a helpful empty state, not evidence of an account failure. Refresh rechecks assignments.
workflows.data: Authorized Offering/Assignment → dated AttendanceSession read model. Include branch zone, as-of time and server-resolved capability.

workflows.title: Resolve a missing or changed assignment

steps.title: Readiness
steps.help: Show the safe reason the teaching day is incomplete.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.help: The teacher cannot repair identity, eligibility or assignments themselves.

workflows.outcome: The teacher has a precise, non-sensitive handoff and a retry route.
workflows.rule: Never widen access, create an assignment or offer another teacher’s session to fill an empty page.
workflows.recovery: If assignment is revoked while open, stop access and clear protected draft data.
workflows.data: Read Access/People/Academics readiness through published minimal contracts. Phase 1 handoff is informational, not a new ticket system.

workflows.title: Review my assigned classes

steps.title: Class context
steps.help: Choose an assigned offering, not an institution-wide class directory.

steps.title: Class workspace
steps.help: Show the relevant year, subject, assignment dates and upcoming sessions.

workflows.outcome: The class workspace explains what the teacher can do and for which dates.
workflows.rule: Recheck the dated assignment on every protected read. Historical visibility follows the current approved access contract, not lifelong access from one past lesson.
workflows.recovery: Ended or changed assignments show unavailable content and an administrator handoff.
workflows.data: Academics Offering/Assignment/Teacher eligibility compose an authorized class DTO; Students supplies only minimal roster facts.

workflows.title: Review a minimal class roster

steps.title: Roster scope
steps.help: The effective class/date determines membership.

steps.title: Student context
steps.help: See only the data needed for assigned teaching.

workflows.outcome: The teacher can identify the correct pupil without gaining full student-record access.
workflows.rule: No institution-wide person search, unrelated pupil directory, bulk pupil export, financial ledger, custody detail or clinical narrative.
workflows.recovery: A pupil joining/leaving on a boundary changes future roster eligibility; already opened session rosters remain frozen.
workflows.data: Students Student → Person → effective Enrollment/SectionPlacement → authorized class. Session view uses frozen roster instead of live enrollment.

workflows.title: Open an assigned attendance session

steps.title: Session context
steps.help: Check subject, class, date and branch-local time.

steps.title: Open register
steps.help: Opening freezes the eligible roster, not its attendance statuses.

fields.name: open
fields.label: This is the intended class session.

workflows.outcome: The exact frozen roster opens with every pupil initially unmarked.
workflows.rule: No default presence or absence. Reauthorize at open and submit; validate current session state and assignment.
workflows.recovery: Empty roster, cancelled session, changed assignment and duplicate open have explicit outcomes. Never manufacture pupils or a replacement session.
workflows.data: AttendanceSession state/roster transaction reads scoped dated enrollment, pins roster and calendar revision, writes audit/receipt without student attendance statuses.

workflows.title: Mark attendance and review exceptions

steps.title: Mark deliberately
steps.help: Use Present, Absent, Late or Excused. Unmarked is a draft state.

steps.title: Check the whole class
steps.help: A filtered view must not hide incomplete rows from final validation.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have checked exceptions and all unmarked pupils.

workflows.outcome: An in-memory draft accurately represents the teacher’s intended register.
workflows.rule: Explicit bulk action states its scope. Mark unmarked present preserves existing exceptions; replacing every status requires a separate confirmation.
workflows.recovery: Search/filter changes never discard edits. Phase 1 reload/navigation may lose unsent input; warn clearly.
workflows.data: UI draft keyed by exact session/roster revision. No browser durable pupil cache, database record or automatic attendance event before submit.

workflows.title: Submit attendance and keep the receipt

steps.title: Review totals
steps.help: Every frozen roster pupil must have one supported status.

fields.name: complete
fields.label: Every pupil has been marked and totals match the roster.

steps.title: Submit once
steps.help: Send one intent with its stable idempotency key and expected revision.

workflows.outcome: An acknowledged immutable submission shows scope, totals, actor, time and receipt reference.
workflows.rule: Validate the full frozen roster atomically. Same key/payload replay returns the same outcome; changed payload with that key conflicts.
workflows.recovery: Do not show success before server acknowledgement. On loss of response, retain the intent and use Check status.
workflows.data: Owner transaction rechecks authorization/guards/version, writes complete attendance records + submission revision + receipt + safe audit/outbox.

workflows.title: Recover an uncertain submission

steps.title: Check status
steps.help: An interrupted response can mean the server has already committed.

fields.name: recovery
fields.label: Recovery action
options: Retry the unchanged request when confirmed safe

steps.title: Resolve the outcome
steps.help: A new key would be a new intent; do not create one blindly.

fields.name: receipt
fields.label: I have resolved the current request before changing the draft.

workflows.outcome: One logical submission is acknowledged without duplicated or overwritten attendance.
workflows.rule: Freeze payload/key while outcome is unknown. Receipt resolution reauthorizes; a receipt key is not a bearer credential.
workflows.recovery: If status check fails, remain Unknown. If not committed and still authorized, retry unchanged intent.
workflows.data: Read owner command receipt/current session using institution, branch, account and resource scope; no new business writes during status lookup.

workflows.title: Handle a stale register or lost permission

steps.title: Understand the change
steps.help: Explain a revision conflict separately from revoked access.

steps.title: Safe next action
steps.help: Protected input can be retained only while the teacher remains authorized.

fields.name: next
fields.label: Action
options: Reload and review current authorized record

workflows.outcome: The teacher resolves a valid conflict or leaves an unavailable record without silent overwrite.
workflows.rule: 409 requires explicit review; 401/403 clears protected draft data. Never silently replay an old roster against a new one.
workflows.recovery: A submitted record stays read-only; an unavailable record does not leak the new teacher or pupils.
workflows.data: Application rechecks live guards and returns safe errors. New reads query owner state under current scope; no automatic mutation.

workflows.title: Review history and hand off a correction

steps.title: Locate the session
steps.help: Use class, date and subject to find the exact submitted register.

steps.title: Correction handoff
steps.help: Teachers cannot directly alter submitted attendance in Phase 1.

workflows.outcome: The teacher understands the recorded result and the administrator’s correction route.
workflows.rule: No attendance.correct from the Teacher role. Show original submission and permitted correction history with safe reasons.
workflows.recovery: If the current assignment no longer authorizes the record, deny rather than revealing historical rosters.
workflows.data: Read Session → frozen roster → effective records/revisions plus scoped receipt. Phase 1 support handoff creates no correction or hidden request record.

workflows.title: Use offline-assisted attendance

steps.title: Prepare an authorized session
steps.help: Offline access needs a separately approved privacy and device design.

fields.name: device
fields.label: This device meets the school’s approved offline policy.

steps.title: Reconnect and reconcile
steps.help: Queued does not mean submitted.

workflows.outcome: An authorized queued intent is reconciled explicitly and then acknowledged.
workflows.rule: Phase 1 remains online-first. Any later durable queue needs expiry, minimization, device protection and reauthorization before replay.
workflows.recovery: Permission revocation, lost device, changed roster, expired queue and competing submission must not silently sync.
workflows.data: Proposed offline intent metadata + protected local payload; owner submission/receipt unchanged. Storage/security design required before coding.

workflows.title: Request an attendance correction

steps.title: Identify the exact record
steps.help: A request is not a correction.

steps.title: Explain
steps.help: Use a minimal reason for authorized review.

fields.name: request
fields.label: Send this request to the authorized attendance reviewer.

workflows.outcome: A proposed request has Pending review / Accepted / Declined states and a linked outcome.
workflows.rule: New extension requiring scope approval. Only the administrator’s attendance.correct command changes the register.
workflows.recovery: Duplicates, withdrawal, permission loss and already-corrected records are handled with traceable decisions.
workflows.data: Proposed CorrectionRequest references session/record/revision; Attendance correction owner records accepted effect and audit. No direct teacher record writes.

workflows.title: Read school notices and acknowledge

steps.title: Notice
steps.help: Open a notice addressed to this teacher.

steps.title: Acknowledge when requested
steps.help: Read, delivered and acknowledged are different states.

workflows.outcome: A required acknowledgement records the teacher’s explicit action.
workflows.rule: Do not infer acknowledgement from an opened page or email tracking. Attachments reauthorize.
workflows.recovery: Edited/withdrawn notice or revoked audience membership has a safe update state.
workflows.data: Communication published notice/version + RecipientSnapshot + explicit acknowledgement; access derived from live audience.

workflows.title: Prepare a class message

steps.title: Message
steps.help: Keep sensitive details out of notification previews.

steps.title: Audience review
steps.help: Show eligible verified recipients and exclusions without exposing private family restrictions.

fields.name: audienceReviewed
fields.label: I have reviewed the intended audience.

steps.title: Submit for approval
steps.help: Direct send is available only when explicitly granted.

workflows.outcome: A message draft or approval request has a visible status.
workflows.rule: Teacher role is not a blanket send grant. Recheck relationship, purpose, consent and module access at actual delivery.
workflows.recovery: Provider failure/unknown is distinct from sent/delivered. Revoked relationships are suppressed, not retried.
workflows.data: Communication owns MessageCampaign, recipient snapshot and delivery attempts; Guardians supplies live purpose grants via a minimal contract.

workflows.title: Reply in a permitted family conversation

steps.title: Conversation context
steps.help: The family and child relationship is checked on every read.

steps.title: Reply
steps.help: Use the approved conversation; do not reveal other children or private contact lists.

workflows.outcome: A reply appears in the authorized thread with its actual delivery state.
workflows.rule: No teacher-created guardian relationship or invitation. A household contact or payer is not automatically a portal guardian.
workflows.recovery: Removed participant or revoked child grant prevents further disclosure; report safely to the school office.
workflows.data: ConversationGrant/Message version references exact child and participants; queued delivery rechecks current grants.

workflows.title: Arrange a family meeting

steps.title: Purpose and participant
steps.help: Use a verified conversation or school-approved scheduling route.

steps.title: Availability
steps.help: Share only offered times, not the teacher’s private calendar.

workflows.outcome: The request is proposed, confirmed, rescheduled or cancelled with an explicit participant response.
workflows.rule: This scheduling extension needs approval and a conflict model before implementation. No student-sensitive detail in public calendars.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent booking, cancellation, time-zone display and guardian revocation require clear recovery.
workflows.data: Proposed MeetingRequest/SlotReservation with participant grants; Communication handles notices separately.

workflows.title: Review permitted absence context
workflows.capability: attendance explanation read purpose; no default approval

steps.title: Student and date
steps.help: Read only the limited explanation permitted for teaching.

steps.title: School handoff
steps.help: Review status does not itself alter the register.

fields.name: next
fields.label: Action
options: Refer a discrepancy to the school office

workflows.outcome: The teacher gets necessary context while the school office controls disposition and correction.
workflows.rule: No clinical attachment, private family dispute or guardian note unless explicitly authorized. No automatic absence inference.
workflows.recovery: Pending explanation, late attendance, revoked relationship and unavailable detail are distinct.
workflows.data: Minimal authorized explanation/request read model; Attendance correction and Guardian relationship owners remain separate.

workflows.title: Review my published timetable

steps.title: Week
steps.help: A published version is distinct from a draft plan.

steps.title: Session details
steps.help: See room, subject and permitted changes with a list alternative to the grid.

workflows.outcome: The teacher can plan against a versioned schedule and identify changes.
workflows.rule: Manual Phase 1 sessions do not imply recurring timetable support. A schedule view never creates attendance records.
workflows.recovery: Draft/unpublished change, room closure and cancelled occurrence clearly identify the current authoritative version.
workflows.data: Academics TimetableVersion/slots + dated assignments and exceptions compose the view; Attendance references generated occurrence source.

workflows.title: Accept and perform a cover assignment

steps.title: Cover request
steps.help: Show class, period and responsibilities before acceptance.

steps.title: Confirm availability
steps.help: Eligibility and clashes are rechecked before making access effective.

workflows.outcome: An authorized cover assignment grants only the exact required session scope.
workflows.rule: Accepting a message alone grants nothing. No shared credentials, administrator impersonation or permanent roster access.
workflows.recovery: Clash, stale request, revoked eligibility and already-opened session follow the approved substitution contract.
workflows.data: Academics owns Substitution/Assignment changes; attendance assignment resolver checks dated scope at every action.

workflows.title: Hand over a lesson or request a schedule change

steps.title: Affected lesson
steps.help: A request does not directly modify the timetable.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.help: Share only necessary teaching context with the authorized recipient.

workflows.outcome: The scheduling owner reviews the request and publishes any approved change.
workflows.rule: Do not move a scheduled session or grant access from a teacher draft. Open/submitted history is preserved.
workflows.recovery: Denied request or changed assignment leaves the original schedule authoritative.
workflows.data: Proposed TimetableChangeRequest links an existing offering/occurrence; Academics executes approval. Learning resources keep their grants.

workflows.title: Plan a lesson

steps.title: Teaching context
steps.help: Prepare against a class, topic and date.

steps.title: Plan
steps.help: Use clear objectives, activities and a check for understanding.

steps.title: Visibility
steps.help: Drafts stay private to authorized teaching staff.

workflows.outcome: A versioned lesson plan can be revisited and reused with deliberate context changes.
workflows.rule: Copying a plan must not copy pupil responses or private notes. Lesson plan is not automatic publication to families.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent edits preserve current revision; lost assignment removes protected content.
workflows.data: Learning owns LessonPlan/revision referencing authorized Offering and safe ResourceReferences.

workflows.title: Add and reuse teaching resources

steps.title: Resource
steps.help: Attach only material the school is permitted to use.

steps.title: Audience
steps.help: File access follows the owning task/plan, not a public link.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed the resource and its intended audience.

workflows.outcome: A safe, versioned resource is attached to the intended lesson or assignment.
workflows.rule: Scan before availability; sanitized preview; scope-bound short-lived downloads; accessible alternative instructions.
workflows.recovery: Upload progress, interruption, scan rejection and revoked audience remain explicit.
workflows.data: Documents FileAsset/ScanResult/DocumentVersion; Learning ResourceReference; read authorization rechecked at download.

workflows.title: Create and publish an assignment

steps.title: Task
steps.help: State what the learner should do and how it will be reviewed.

steps.title: Submission
steps.help: Use explicit deadline and accepted mode.

steps.title: Publication review
steps.help: Check audience, resources, accessibility and due date before publishing.

fields.name: publish
fields.label: I have reviewed the class-facing task.

workflows.outcome: The exact published assignment version is visible to the eligible class.
workflows.rule: Publication requires current assignment and enrollment grants. Do not confuse Save draft with Publish.
workflows.recovery: Changed deadline publishes a reviewed revision and notice; unknown publish outcome uses a receipt.
workflows.data: Learning Assignment/Version and audience criteria; durable publication manifest/event; Communication notice is separate from published content.

workflows.title: Review submissions and late work

steps.title: Worklist
steps.help: Submitted, missing, late and returned are separate states.

steps.title: Review work
steps.help: Open only the current authorized submission revision.

workflows.outcome: The teacher can act on each learner’s actual submission state.
workflows.rule: Missing is not a numeric zero. Submission revisions and late policy are pinned; never leak one pupil’s work to another.
workflows.recovery: Interrupted upload, withdrawn enrollment, missing file and malware rejection have distinct explanations.
workflows.data: Learning SubmissionRevision + published Assignment version + enrollment grant; Documents enforces file readiness and download scope.

workflows.title: Draft feedback and return work

steps.title: Feedback
steps.help: Give actionable guidance on the selected work.

steps.title: Return review
steps.help: Preview exactly what the learner and permitted guardian will see.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have checked the audience and selected work revision.

workflows.outcome: A private draft remains private; returned feedback identifies its published revision.
workflows.rule: Saving feedback is not result publication or automatic assessment grading. Family visibility needs separate purpose and module grants.
workflows.recovery: Submission changed while grading requires comparison; missing authority stops publication.
workflows.data: Learning Feedback revision pins SubmissionRevision; explicit return manifest + safe audit/outbox; no unintended result-table writes.

workflows.title: Allow resubmission or revise a deadline

steps.title: Change scope
steps.help: Choose whole class or one authorized learner.

steps.title: Explain change
steps.help: Keep previous deadlines and submissions in history.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed who is affected and which version remains visible.

workflows.outcome: The revised policy and optional resubmission path are explicit to affected learners.
workflows.rule: No silent retrospective penalty changes; preserve already published feedback and submission history.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent publication, offline upload and revoked enrollment reconcile against the pinned policy.
workflows.data: Assignment revision / per-learner exception and SubmissionRevision lineage; authorized notice event.

workflows.title: Review learning progress and plan support

steps.title: Review evidence
steps.help: Use visible source tasks and transparent completeness.

steps.title: Plan next action
steps.help: Support decisions remain human and role-scoped.

workflows.outcome: The teacher can explain a support action from permitted learning evidence.
workflows.rule: No opaque risk scores, permanent labels or inference from missing data. A confidential support case needs a separate grant.
workflows.recovery: Sparse evidence and changed enrollment limit conclusions; never turn unavailable data into poor performance.
workflows.data: Learning read projection of assignments, submissions and returned feedback; proposed support task references sources and minimizes pupil notes.

workflows.title: Prepare an assessment within an approved scheme

steps.title: Assessment context
steps.help: Use the approved scheme version, boundaries and rounding rules.

steps.title: Assessment details
steps.help: Make expectations clear before marks entry.

workflows.outcome: A scoped assessment is prepared under a pinned scheme.
workflows.rule: Teachers do not change the institution’s grading policy by editing a screen. Approved publication authority remains separate.
workflows.recovery: Scheme revision, invalid max score, conflicting dates and lost subject assignment require review.
workflows.data: Assessment with SchemeVersion reference; no marks or published result created at plan save.

workflows.title: Enter and validate marks

steps.title: Student outcome
steps.help: Not entered, scored, absent and exempt are distinct.

steps.title: Review before saving
steps.help: Validate bounds and completeness using the pinned scheme.

fields.name: review
fields.label: I have reviewed the marks and explicit non-score states.

workflows.outcome: A draft mark revision is saved without publishing results to families.
workflows.rule: Exact validated score scale; zero is a legitimate score, not a stand-in for missing. Exemption authority may be separately required.
workflows.recovery: Two-editor conflict, changed scheme, missing evidence and withdrawn enrollment do not silently overwrite.
workflows.data: Assessment MarkRevision with state, exact score and expected version; draft save receipt/audit, no ResultPublication change.

workflows.title: Submit marks for moderation
workflows.capability: assessment.submit for owned marks; moderator action separately delegated

steps.title: Readiness
steps.help: Check required marks and unresolved exceptions.

fields.name: ready
fields.label: The configured readiness checks are satisfied.

steps.title: Submit reviewed revision
steps.help: Moderators see the exact submitted version.

workflows.outcome: The selected revision is awaiting moderation or returned with a reason.
workflows.rule: Teacher submission does not approve its own marks by default. Explicit delegation governs moderator actions.
workflows.recovery: Any changed marks invalidate the previous approval scope; returned marks keep review history.
workflows.data: Assessment moderation/approval request pins MarkRevisions; owner transaction prevents stale submit/approve races.

workflows.title: Review result publication and correct an error
workflows.capability: own-subject result preview; correction request, not default publish

steps.title: Published version
steps.help: Read the approved result and its provenance.

steps.title: Error handoff
steps.help: A published result is corrected through reviewed republication.

workflows.outcome: An authorized publisher reviews any correction; the teacher sees the linked disposition.
workflows.rule: No editing a published PDF or overwriting published mark history. Guardian access remains separately permitted.
workflows.recovery: Withdrawn approval or changed underlying marks blocks publication until reconciled.
workflows.data: ResultPublicationManifest references approved revisions; proposed correction request routes to assessment owner, preserving original publication.

workflows.title: Refer a student concern safely

steps.title: Minimal referral
steps.help: Use the school’s approved reporting protocol. Do not include clinical detail in shared notes.

steps.title: Restricted handoff
steps.help: Only the authorized specialist receives sensitive details through the approved channel.

workflows.outcome: A minimal referral is handed to an authorized specialist with accountable status.
workflows.rule: Teacher role gives no full clinical, custody or safeguarding case access. No automatic parent notification for a sensitive concern.
workflows.recovery: Unavailable recipient or urgent danger uses the approved human escalation protocol; do not leave an urgent case in a generic queue.
workflows.data: Restricted referral metadata and purpose grant; specialist case remains owned by Health/Safeguarding. General audit carries only safe references.

workflows.title: Request leave and arrange a handoff

steps.title: Leave request
steps.help: Only your own balances and requests are shown.

steps.title: Teaching impact
steps.help: Requesting leave does not automatically cancel class sessions.

workflows.outcome: The request is pending, approved, returned or declined with a clear reason.
workflows.rule: Coverage belongs to the timetable owner; pupil and staff attendance are different domains. Sensitive leave evidence is restricted.
workflows.recovery: Insufficient balance, overlapping request or changed approval authority blocks/returns appropriately.
workflows.data: People operations LeaveRequest and versioned balance policy; ledger debit on approved transition; Academics cover handoff is separate.

workflows.title: Review my staff record and request a correction

steps.title: My details
steps.help: Employment records are separate from login identity.

steps.title: Correction request
steps.help: Only the record owner can approve controlled changes.

workflows.outcome: An own-record request has a traceable decision.
workflows.rule: No view of colleagues’ personal records or payroll; bank/salary changes require a separately designed sensitive process.
workflows.recovery: Revoked employment, disputed evidence and duplicate requests route to the authorized HR owner.
workflows.data: Employee safe self projection and proposed StaffCorrectionRequest; approved changes use People operations owner commands.

workflows.title: Borrow, reserve or renew a resource

steps.title: Find resource
steps.help: Search permitted catalog items, not other borrowers’ history.

steps.title: Request
steps.help: Current eligibility and hold policy determine availability.

workflows.outcome: The teacher sees their own loan/reservation and due date.
workflows.rule: A request is not a confirmed checkout until the circulation owner records it. No authority to waive fines or edit another borrower.
workflows.recovery: Already loaned copy, hold queue, renewal limit and lost item have explicit outcomes.
workflows.data: Library CatalogItem/Copy/Loan/Reservation read contracts; teacher requests are scoped to own borrower identity.

workflows.title: Request materials or book a teaching space

steps.title: Request
steps.help: Choose a teaching need and time.

steps.title: Purpose
steps.help: Inventory custody and room scheduling remain explicit.

workflows.outcome: The request is confirmed only after availability and approval checks.
workflows.rule: No direct stock adjustment or room double-booking; timetable commitments and maintenance blocks apply.
workflows.recovery: Concurrent booking, unavailable quantity, overdue return and changed class schedule need reviewed alternatives.
workflows.data: Facilities booking range and Inventory request/custody references; authorized owner commands append movements and reservations.

workflows.title: Carry out an assigned school duty
workflows.capability: explicit dated duty / minimal roster grant (proposed)

steps.title: Duty scope
steps.help: An event or transport duty does not grant full student access.

steps.title: Record accountable handoff
steps.help: Follow the approved duty-specific procedure.

workflows.outcome: The assigned duty records a minimal outcome and responsible handoff.
workflows.rule: Proposed extension: explicit activity-specific grant, dates and authorized pickup/handoff rules must precede implementation. No unrestricted live child location.
workflows.recovery: Wrong-child handoff, missing pickup authority or offline uncertainty uses the approved human fallback.
